instruction: Rework required. Current init already persists the default authority section, so the fixture must replace its empty approval_receipts trust list rather than reject or duplicate authority.

findings.summary: The clean packaged run failed at the explicit fail-closed guard because WORKFLOW.md already contains authority from defaultConfig/saveConfig.
The narrow correction is to replace the canonical default approval_receipts mapping with the fixture issuer, preserving manual authority mode and every unrelated workflow field.
The replacement should require an exact single default marker and fail closed on any unexpected generated shape.
